note: An AD-HOC reference constructed between just these two REST interfaces (MEF Sonata product ordering, X; TMF641 service ordering, Y) for just this seam — not adopted from any standard. One entry per shared seam category, each pinned by a canonical example both sides can instantiate. It deliberately does NOT cover either side's native concepts (state, itemTerm, serviceSpecification, supportingService), which is how it pre-empts the surface-identical 'state' false cognate: 'state' fits no entry, so the two states do not correspond. Each definition pins the cross-layer meaning (commercial product vs technical service) so it cannot be silently misread across the seam.

entries.label: order envelope
entries.definition: The order container exchanged at the seam: a product order on the buyer/seller side and the service order the operator raises to fulfil it are the same order envelope, seen commercially versus technically.
entries.example: product order PO-88 is fulfilled by service order SO-88

entries.label: orderable item
entries.definition: One orderable line carrying an action on a single delivered construct: a product order item and the service order item that realises it are the same orderable line at the seam.
entries.example: product item-1 (add EVPL) corresponds to service item-1 (add EVPL service)

entries.label: delivered construct
entries.definition: The construct being delivered at the seam. The commercial PRODUCT ordered and the technical SERVICE that realises it denote the same delivered connectivity, seen commercially versus technically — NOT the product-vs-service distinction of a catalogue.
entries.example: the ordered EVPL product is realised by the activated EVPL service

entries.label: technical parameters
entries.definition: The technical parameters of the delivered construct, however each side structures them: the MEF product configuration and the TMF service characteristics pin the same bandwidth, class of service and UNI values.
entries.example: product config CIR 100M / CoS Gold is the same requirement as service characteristics bandwidth 100M / cos gold

entries.label: service site
entries.definition: The geographic site of delivery: the product's related place (the UNI location) and the service's place are the same physical demarcation point.
entries.example: UNI at 350 E St is the same site as the service termination at 350 E St
